review_notes: This is a recovery-status report for widespread Karnali Highway damage after several days of rain. It covers many landslide points across Kalikot, Jumla and the Nagma-Gamgadhi corridor without isolating individual dated physical failures.

review_notes: The article describes households facing future landslide risk in Pipaldali, Bajura; it does not document an observed dated landslide failure.

review_notes: The report aggregates a three-kilometre damaged section at Rarahili, eight-to-ten landslide points across Hima/Kanakasundari, and several Mugu sites caused by the previous week's rain. Individual dated physical failures cannot be reconstructed safely.

review_notes: The Khotang fatality was caused by a man being swept away by a stream. The landslide deaths mentioned in the same article occurred in Ilam, so no Khotang landslide event is supported.

review_notes: The article gives municipality-level casualty totals across Dhulikhel, Banepa, Panauti, Namobuddha and Bhumlu but no site or incident narratives. It therefore cannot support individually defined physical landslide events.

review_notes: The article is about helicopter evacuation of two maternity patients after broad flood/landslide damage to transport access. It does not identify an individual dated landslide event in Falelung-3.

review_notes: This is a prevention/risk article about possible renewed failure at Krishnabhir and historical or prior-monsoon slope damage. It does not document a new landslide occurring on the article date.
